maintainedIntentionalDifferences: Calendar 11 PM versus erroneous reference 23 AM
Appearance Escape restores focus to the trigger instead of losing it
Composer aria-expanded correctly true while its menu is open instead of reference false
Invalid kanban drops cancel without losing the card
investigationCorrections: An initial hypothesis that every viewport selection resets Card was narrowed after probing the full sequence: Desktop preserves Background
The first wide-sheet image comparison exposed a fixture field-type mismatch; the final capture uses the corrected link field type
Diagnostic tests initially tried covered mobile header controls; the final tests check hit testing and use Escape without forced clicks
The initial primitive JSON was preserved for ARIA diagnosis, but its image paths were overwritten by final captures and are not treated as before-fix image evidence
